ideal: Each repo sits on its chosen side: a private one shows nothing signed out; a public one has no personal email and scans for secrets.

sources.title: Changing the visibility of your GitHub Pages site

quality: No private repo has a public page, and no public repo shows a personal email or runs without secret scanning.
speed: One run audits the whole org within a minute.
consumption: An audit spends a small share of the token's hourly requests.
